text:
Nina - CS: Heads-up: GraniteLabs private deploy is next week. Need final confirmations for VPC peering, IAM role, KMS grants, and log shipping.
Ravi - NetEng: Peering is mostly configured. Waiting on their side for the exact worker CIDR block and whether they will use a fixed NAT EIP. Requested at 08:40 PT.
Olga - Security: IAM: they prefer cross-account role with constrained permissions. Please ask them to share the role ARN + trust policy. For KMS we need either a key ID or permission to create a key on their account.
Jon - Platform: App will fail healthchecks without egress routes. Also highlight that webhook callbacks must come from a stable IP range; if they use ephemeral addresses we need a fallback plan.
Nina - CS: Renewal health is positive but fragile. If cutover encounters repeated outages, we'll surface to CSM lead. I'll flag a risk line in Salesforce.
Ravi - NetEng: Asked for `10.200.16.0/28` as a suggestion for workers. They replied saying they might prefer /27. Need final from their infra owner.
Olga - Security: Shared a minimal KMS grant example with them: `{"GranteePrincipal":"arn:aws:iam::999111222333:role/GraniteCrossAcc","Operations":["Encrypt","Decrypt"]}`. Asked for confirmation of key rotation.
Jon - Platform: Request: can we get the S3 audit bucket ARN and whether they require SSE-KMS? We'll only deliver logs if bucket policy allows our delivery principal.
ops-bot: Reminder: granite-deploy-window scheduled 2031-08-12T18:00Z -> 2031-08-12T22:00Z
Nina - CS: Action list I'm tracking: (Ravi) finalize CIDR + NAT EIP; (Olga) finalize role ARN + KMS key ID + rotation policy; (Jon) verify webhook allowlist + runbook smoke tests.
Ravi - NetEng: I'll escalate to their network lead at 14:00 PT if we don't get CIDR.
Olga - Security: Also asked whether they want our service principal to assume their role or prefer granting our principal direct IAM permissions. Different audit trail either way.
Jon - Platform: I'll draft a 3-step smoke test (API ping, callback, log ingestion) and add a step to verify envelope encryption. ETA 15:30 PT.
Nina - CS: Can we add a short feedback pulse (3 questions) to send 24 hours after cutover? Looking for friction points only.
Ravi - NetEng: Received tentative NAT EIP `34.210.55.13` but asked them to confirm whether its reserved.
Olga - Security: Got role ARN `arn:aws:iam::999111222333:role/GraniteLabs-Deployment-Role`. Preparing KMS grant template now.
Jon - Platform: Noted EIP; will update allowlist once confirmed. I'll also mute retries for the first hour to reduce noise.
Nina - CS: Thanks. If any of the core items (CIDR, role ARN, bucket ARN) are missing by EOD I'll open escalation.
Ravi - NetEng: Quick FYI: if they pick /27 we'll need to update our TGW route entries.
Olga - Security: Sending the KMS grant template and a short checklist for audit delivery now.
Nina - CS: I'll post the consolidated checklist to the onboarding doc and invite GraniteLabs infra lead to the cutover call.
Jon - Platform: Will attach the smoke test link when ready.
Nina - CS: Closing for now. Please keep updates concise in-thread so I can timestamp progress for the account record. :spiral_note_pad:
